name: OS Client Certs -- decrypt & re-encrypt S/MIME forward
description: When forwarding an S/MIME encrypted message, automatically decrypt the original, replace the raw smime.p7m blob with the decrypted content and attachments, and re-enable S/MIME encryption for the new recipients. Requires identity with S/MIME signing/encryption certificates. v0.3.1 (TEST): privileged ForwardIntercept Experiment redirects a forward directly to a reply (clears recipients + Re: -> Fwd: retitle at compose-open, no window flicker); debug-only probe now dumps the getFull(decrypt:true) tree to decide how standalone file attachments are forwarded.
